title: Pilot paths (three ways in)
description: A saturated violet band: a centred white heading over a square-cornered split, a tall white card on the left (title, copy, violet pill, and a portrait slot rising from a big dotted butter-yellow disc) and, on the right, an aubergine card with an outlined pill and a pink wash in its corner over a pale lilac card with violet text and pink-underlined inline links. Ends on white closing lines with a pink brush stroke. Stacks on phones.
notes: the band is the theme's primary colour; the dark card is secondary, the light card glow at 15% over the page colour
